title: EEG-Captioner: Grounding EEG-to-Language Generation in Fundamental Signal Properties
abstract: arXiv:2610.30995v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG)-to-language models offer a promising approach for translating complex neural signals into human-readable descriptions. However, generating plausible language does not necessarily demonstrate that a model has learned to interpret the underlying EEG signal. A direct way to assess such interpretation is to probe objectively measurable properties of the signal itself. We therefore construct an EEG-language dataset of 160,781 segments annotated with signal-level question answering (QA) pairs, where each question targets one of five property families and requires a quantitative comparison involving spectral, spatial, temporal, or lateral signal properties. translated_title: EEG-Captioner：基于基本信号属性的脑电到语言生成
translated_abstract: 脑电图（EEG）到语言模型为将复杂的神经信号翻译成人类可读的描述提供了一种有前景的方法。然而，生成看似合理的语言并不一定证明模型真正学会了解读底层的EEG信号。评估这种解读能力的一个直接方法是探测信号本身可客观测量的属性。因此，我们构建了一个包含160,781个片段的EEG-语言数据集，该数据集标注了信号级问答（QA）对，其中每个问题针对五类属性族之一，并需要涉及频谱、空间、时间或侧向信号属性的定量比较。每个片段还配有一个基于特征的EEG描述。我们进一步提出了一种双域EEG编码器，它联合建模时间波形与频谱-空间表示，并引入了EEG-Captioner——一个统一的EEG到语言框架，其训练采用……
tldr: 提出了EEG-Captioner统一框架及包含16万余个片段、以信号级问答标注的EEG-语言数据集，通过让模型回答关于频谱、空间、时间、侧向等可测量信号属性的问题，来验证EEG到语言生成确实建立在对脑电信号的真实解读之上，并采用双域编码器联合建模时间波形与频谱-空间表示。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces EEG-Captioner, a unified EEG-to-language framework grounded in measurable signal properties, built on a 160,781-segment QA-annotated dataset probing spectral, spatial, temporal, and lateral EEG features, with a Dual-Domain EEG Encoder that jointly models temporal waveforms and spectral-spatial representations.
